translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Pilato Jesúsga igal-itojad
Tegidgin Judio-tummagan-ormabukmalad-pel-kwapa aknidmalgu, ilgwen Pilatoje Jesús-chesmalzhun Jesúsga igal-itogal.

Tegin Judio-tummagan Pilatoje omosgu, Pilatoga Jesús-tuktialmal, chogalmal: —Imi anmal takalmaldo, we tule anmal-tulemal-pinzheed kadii Romano-abin-kwisgugal. Tenal we tule chogdo, anmalde melle Romano-Tummad-Césarga mani-egwannanimalad pal penuko. Tegin we tule chogbal, ede Cristo-Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule. Tegin we tule chogbal, ede Judio-erreyga maibal.
Tegin Pilato Jesúszhe ekichial: —¿Chunnají pe Judio-erreyzhí? Tegin Jesús Pilatoga chogalzhun: —Imi pe nabir chogzhado. Antin a-tuledo.
Tegin Pilato tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummaganga tegin tulemalga chogalzhun: —Imi an takto, we tule immal kwen akaloszhul.

Tenal Judio-tummagan kannan-kannan Pilatoga chognaigual: —Tenal we tule pel-kwapa Provincia-Judeagin tulemal-oturdadiidbal, tulemal-oulusmal Romano-tummagan-abin-kwisgugal. Imi we tule kepegin Provincia-Galileagin tulemal-oulusmal, tegin itije-pakal tulemal-ournonimalbal.
Errey-Herode Jesúsga igal-itojad
Tegin Pilato itosgu Jesúsde kepegin Provincia-Galileagin kudigus, Judio-tummaganzhe ekichial: —¿Imi we Jesúsde Galilea-tolzhí? Tegin Judio-tummagan Pilatoga chogalmal: —Teobdo.
Tenal Pilato itosgu Jesús Herode-neg-takmaidgin-tani, Herodeje Jesús-palmiszhun. Imi teun takalgu, Herode Jerusaléngin maimo. Al Pilato Herodeje Jesús-palmiszhun.

Tenal teun Herode Jesús-takchagu eje tani, weligwal itononi. Imi Herode itodi-kus Jesús immal-taktijulmalad imadii. Al Herode imial Jesús-takpi-kudii, Jesús e-wagin immal-taktijulid imagalmo. Al Herode tikajulgus Jesús-takpi-kudiin.
Tenal Herode peyedzhe Jesúszhe immal ekisnaigual. Tenal Jesús ilgwen yakir pes, Herodega immal kwen chogzhajul-kus.
Tenal tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan tegin Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad kannan-kannan pul pela-pela Jesús-tuktigalmal.
Tenal Herode aga e-chulubmalbak istar Jesúsgin todoalmal, tegin Jesúsgin istar chunmakalmalbal. Tegin chulubmal Jesúsgin mol-yér-takleged yosmal. Tegin Herode kannan Pilatoje Jesús-palmisbal.
Imi teun Herode kusgu Pilatobak aga aichulmalan. Tenal Herode Jesúsga-igal-itojad-akar Pilatobak aga ai-nuedga imanonimalzhun.
Pilato Judio-tummaganga igal-ukchad nakrusgin Jesús-piokkal
Tegin Pilato tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummaganzhe tegin Judio-tummagan-pimaladzhe tegin tulemal-yogasalmaladzhe pel-kwapa kocha. Tegin Pilato tulemalga chogal:

—Imi pemal anche we tule-cheinonimal. Tegin pemal chogmal, we tulede tulemal-pinzheed kadii Romano-tummagangin ourwegal. Tenal antin we tuleje pél immal ekichis, ibi akalos-ade. Tenal antin we tulegin-immal-akalodiid kwen onoszhul-kus.
Imi Herode anmalzhe kannan Jesús-palmialidbal, al anmal wismal, Herode Jesús-immal-akalodiid kwen onoszhulmo. Al pemal mag itogenabmal we tule kwen purkwed-wilubzhul.
Tenal antin we tule-wis-oturdane tegin an kannan ne-ononebal.
Tenal Pab-Najad-Itoged-naidbal, Pilato keg-chulgu igal-maidbal tule-walgwen-onoed-wilub. Al Pilato Jesús-onobi-kual.
Tenal tulemal pulakwa kotemal chogalmal: —¡We tule pe mejo! ¡Barrabásdin pe onogo!
(Imi we Barrabás Jerusaléngin Romano-tulemalbak urwedi-kujadbal tegin tulemal-mechadbal, oturdaleged-neggin mellejii.)
Tenal Pilato Jesús-onobi-kunaidbal tulemalga kannan chogalbal: —¿An Jesús-ononeé?
Tenal tulemal kannan-kannan pulakwa kolnanimal chognanimal: —¡We Jesús nakrusgin pe tar-pioko!

Tegin Pilato ilapágus tulemalga chogedgin, chogal: —¿Ibiga an nakrusgin Jesús-pioko-ade? ¿Ibi akalos-ade purkwegal? Imi an Jesúsgin immal-akalojad kwen onoszhul purkwegal. Al an Jesús-wis-oturdane, tegin an kannan ne-ononebal.
Tenal tulemal sapejul kotemal chogalmal: —Imi pedin keg-chulgu nakrusgin-nai Jesús-mejenab. Tegin tulemal yabli Pilatogin nakwismal Jesús-mesgal.
Tegin Pilato chogalzhun Judiomal akalzhul nakrusgin-nai Jesús-mesmalzhunno.

Imi Barrabás Jerusalén-neg-kweburgin Romano-tummaganbak urwedi-kus tegin tulemal-mechabal. Tenal tulemal-Pilatoje-ekichijadbal, Pilato yabli Barrabás-onos. Tenal Pilato Judio-tummaganga Jesús-ukchajun, Judio-tummagan aga itolegedbal Jesús-mesgal.
Chulubmal nakrusgin Jesús-piokchamalad

Tegin chulubmal nakrusgin piokkal Jesús-cheinatapmaladgin, Simón-Cirenegined-kasmal Jesúsga nakrus chedgal. Imi we Simóndin a-ito Jerusalénzhe tanikin. Tenal chulubmal kantikidgin Simóngin nakrus mezhismal, Jesús-cholbal nakrus chedgal.
Tenal tulemal-íchejul Jesús-cholbal irmadanimalmo. Imi teun omegan pukib-itogedbal Jesúsga nakpodanimalmo, kwen okormadanimal.
Tegidgin Jesús omeganzhik akpiridgu, omeganga chogal: “Omegan-Jerusalénginmalad, pe melle anka pomalma. Pemal aga tukin pomalma, tegin pe aga nuskanga.

Imi pemalga kujal neg-puled-noniko. Tenal pemalga neg-puled-nonikil, nuskan-peyedzhe-wilenoniko. Al pemal chogdamalo: ‘Imi omegan-kusgu-wichul-nuchu-pakmaladga, ib-nuedga kus. Tegin omegan-ampayo-nuskan-nikumaladga, ib-nuedga kusmo. Tegin omegan-nugin-nuchu-okuchajulmaladga, ib-nuedga kusmo.’
Tegin te ibe-nonikoedgin,
“Imi tule chapi-wal-makidgin sapejul immal imanail, tegin chapi-wal kujal tinkunonikil, ¿we tulemal pul sapejul immal imamalojulzhi? Teobdo.” Teob Jesús chogzhagus.
Imi teun chulubmal Jesúsbak walbo tule-iskana-cheimamimalmo nakrusgin piokkalmo.

Tegin chulubmal Tule-Nono-Kal-Yal-neg-nugadzhe Jesús-cheinonimalgu, we yalgin nakrusgin Jesús-piokchamalzhun. Tegin chulubmal nakrus-pidgin tule-iskana-piokchamalmo, kwén Jesús-nuedzhik, kwéntin Jesús-chapilezhik.

Tegidgin Jesús chogal: —Pabye, we tulemal-sapejul-an-imananimaladga pe chogo: ‘Pe-iskueddin pelgusye.’ Imi we tulemal immal kwen wichulmal, ibi ankin imananimalye. Tegin chulubmal Jesús-molgin todoalmal, toa pul-melu aga mol chumalo.

Tenal tulemal pel-kwapa Jesús-takpukmal. Tenal Judio-tummagan istar Jesúsgin chunmakalmal chogalmal: —Imi we tule, tule-pimalad-abonos. Tenal we tule chunchunnad Pab-Tummad-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-Cristol, tegin Pab we tule-chusbalil, nakrusgin-naid-akar aga tukin abonodo.
Tegin chulubmal Jesús-waglik kwisgunonimalgu, Jesúsgin todoalmal. Tegin chulubmal Jesúsga vino-kakpid uknain, tenal Jesús yabli kwen kobzhajul-kus.
Tegin chulubmal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi pe chunchunnad Judiomal-e-erreyel, pe aga tukin nakrusgin-naid-akar pe-abonodo.
Tegin Jesús-nakrus-tukugin karta (kaka-chogapá nermakal nai, Griego-kakagin, Romano-kakagin tegin Judio-kakagin nermakal-naimo). Tenal karta-nermakal-naid chognaido: WE TULE JUDIOMAL-E-ERREY.

Tegin tule-immal-aturzhemalad-walgwen Jesús-yalbal-nakrusgin-naid istar Jesúsgin chunmakalmo. Tegin we tule Jesúsga chogal: —Imi pe Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule chunchunnadil, pe aga tukin nakrusgin-naid-akar pe-abonodo. Tegin pe anmal-abonomogo.
Tenal tule-immal-aturzhemalad-piddin aga e-pakadga chogal: —¿Ibiga pe weob we tulega chogdé? Imi pe we tule-yopí pe purkwenemo. Tede, ¿ampa pe Pab-Tummad-kwen-tobzhul?
Imi anmal-walbogid immal-akalojadbal nabir oturdalenai. Tenal we tule immal kwen akaloszhul. Al we tule weob oturdaleged-wilubzhulin.
Tegin tule-immal-aturzheed-e-pakad-abin-imajad Jesúsga chogal: —Jesúsye, imi pe neg-takoed omojal, pe ankin wis pinzhemogoye.
Tegin Jesús tule-immal-aturzheedga chogal: —Tegil pe imis Pab-neg-nuedgin anpak mes megwitapmogo.
Jesús nakrusgin-nai purkwijad
Tegin yorokudanikid-akar wachilapáje neg-pel-kwapa chichidbi naigus.
Imi teun tadgwa mommó kanai-pes. Tegin Pabzhe-koled-neggin mol-naid apallala islis.
Tegin Jesús sapejul kotegu, chogal: —Pabye, an pega purpa ukye, pe an-takegalye. Tegin Jesús weob chogzhagu, ilgwen purkwis.
Tenal chulub-tummad pél immal-kujad takchagu, Pab-Tummad-otummoal chogal: —¿We tule chunchunnad immal-kwen-akaloszhulid-taklebalí?
Tegin tule-pel-kwapa-aka-tégin-takpukmalad immal-kujad takchamalgu, pukib-itogedbal aga negzhe twisgal-ebionani nadmal.
Tegin tulemal-pel-kwapa mag-Jesús-takmalad, tegin omegan-Galilea-akar-Jesúsbak-nonimalad-ugakche, panna Jesúsgin-pél-immal-kunaid takpukmal-pes.
Tule Jesús-mui-tigzhamalad

Imi teun tule-walgwen-José-nugad maimo. Tenal we tule neg-kwebur-Arimateagined. Tenal we neg-kweburdin Provincia-Judeagin chii. Tenal Josédin Judio-tummagan-wala-tulapá-kakaambegwad-walgwen. Tenal José tule-nued, tegin tule-innikigwad.
Tenal akpene Judio-tummagan ormasmalgu Jesús-mesgal, we José tummaganbal kwen naiguszhul. Tenal José Pab-neg-takmaid abintadimogan.
Tegin José Pilatoje nad Jesús-mui-ekisgal tiggal.

Tegin Pilato Joséga igal-ukchagu, José nakrus-akar Jesús-mui odeszhun. Tegin José kep mol-chibugin Jesús-mui ebirmas. Tegin José akwapir-chobaled-yabal Jesús-mui-odos. Tenal we akwapir-chobaled-ya ampa-tule-kwen-tigledijulid.
Imi teun itogedga-immal-nudaked-ibe nai, tegin ulukued-ibe pato omodanibal.
Tenal omegan-Galilea-akar-Jesúsbak-nonimalad José-cholbal pinna-pinna nadmal, takegal Joséde pia Jesús-mui-tigo-dewa. Tegin omegan nuekwa takchagu pia José Jesús-mui tigzha, kannan negzhe nadmalzhun.

Tegin omegan iktualeba kuakwa ina-ti-wawad amismal, tegin ina-wawad-kwamakaled imasbal, ulukued-ibe-cholbal Jesús-muigin imagal. Tegin omegan ulukued-ibegin wis ulukusmal, Pab Tummad Moisésbal igal-mezhijadyob.
